items.t: Mock wanted poster. Three suspects and an accomplice, drawn from unflattering angles, charges listed as extremely minor.
Mock theatre playbill. Cast list with invented roles, one review quote of four words, all of it hand set.
Mock school photo day composite. Individual portraits in a grid with a group shot below, one person blinking.
Mock protest placard held up in a crowd of one. Cardboard, marker, a cause nobody else would march for.
Mock nutritional label. The group as a product, ingredients listed as behaviours, serving size one household.

alt.1: Mock nutritional label. One person as a product, ingredients listed as behaviours, serving size one household.

items.t: Mock museum exhibit label beside the actual exhibit, which is all {N} of them mid argument in a case with room enough to hold them comfortably.

alt.1: Mock museum exhibit label beside the actual exhibit, which is one person mid sentence in a case with room enough to hold them comfortably.
alt.2: Mock museum exhibit label beside the actual exhibit, which is both of them mid argument in a case with room enough to hold them comfortably.

items.t: Mock seed packet. The cast as a variety of plant, growing instructions absurd, a drawing of what to expect.

alt.1: Mock seed packet. One person as a variety of plant, growing instructions absurd, a drawing of what to expect.

items.t: Mock vintage matchbook. Tiny format, one bold image, one line of type, worn at the fold.
Mock vinyl record inner sleeve. Lyrics replaced with things people actually said this week, hand written.
Mock local newspaper front page. One headline about nothing, the group photographed badly under it.

alt.1: Mock local newspaper front page. One headline about nothing, one person photographed badly under it.

items.t: Mock crisps packet. Flavour named after a personality trait, mascot doing something the flavour would do.
Mock instruction poster for a fire drill, but for a meltdown. Calm diagram figures, clear steps, quietly kind.
Enamel pin set on a backing card. Four to six pins, each one an object that stands for a person, no faces.
Fridge door. Magnets, notes, a school style photo, a shopping list, all of it telling you who lives here.
Keyring collection laid on a table, one per person, worn in ways that say who owns which.
Passport stamp page. Invented stamps for places they have been together, one for the kitchen.
Embroidered patch set. Chunky stitched badges, one per member, a team crest that is mostly a cat.
Board game player pieces and cards laid out, each piece unmistakably one of the cast.

alt.1: Board game player pieces and cards laid out, every piece unmistakably the same person.

items.t: A wall of polaroids held with washi tape, six to nine, candid, some blurry, one upside down.
Cross stitch sampler. The cast in tiny pixel form with a motto stitched beneath.

alt.1: Cross stitch sampler. One figure in tiny pixel form with a motto stitched beneath.

items.t: Two panels. Before and after, same framing, one thing has gone wrong in between.
Three panels. Setup, escalation, {4} entering.

alt.1: Three panels. Setup, escalation, and {1} noticing far too late.
alt.2: Three panels. Setup, escalation, {2} arriving at precisely the wrong moment.
alt.3: Three panels. Setup, escalation, and {3} walking in on the result.

items.t: Four panels in a square. A plan, its execution, its failure, and everyone pretending it worked.

alt.1: Four panels in a square. A plan, its execution, its failure, and one person pretending it worked.

items.t: Six small panels in two rows. The same room across one day, the mess accumulating.
A tall vertical strip read downward, each panel one step lower on a staircase, something getting dropped.
A wide filmstrip. Five frames of the same second, motion caught between them.
Comic page with one large panel and three small inset reactions.
Storyboard sheet with rough panel borders, arrows for movement, a scribbled note under each.
